title: S + Z = [[G ∖ Q_r]] × S₀ + [[Q_r]] × S₀′ + E′ on test forms, hence M_W(S + Z) ≤ M_W(A₁) + M_W(A₂) + M(E′)
statement: Let P, k, m, n ∈ ℕ with h : n = k + m, let g = (g_1, …, g_k) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) be orthonormal with span G := span{g_1, …, g_k}, H^k := μHE[k], r ∈ ℝ, Q_r := {t ∈ G : |⟨g_i, t⟩| ≤ r for all i}, and let W ⊆ ℝ^P be any set. Let S₀, S₀′ ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) be represented by IMReps R₀, R₀′ (IMRep univ m) whose measures are carried by G^⊥: R₀.measure(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥) = 0 and R₀′.measure(ℝ^P ∖ G^⊥) = 0. Let S, Z, E′, A₁, A₂, S′ ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) be such that, for every map flat : Λ^n → Λ^m (Λ^j := Covector (Euclid P) j) with flat α v = α(Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h) for all α, v and every test n-form ω, writing f_T(t) := currentEval T (y ↦ flat(ω(t + y))): S(ω) = ∫_G f_{S₀} dH^k; Z(ω) = ∫_{Q_r} f_{S₀′−S₀} dH^k + E′(ω) (S₀′ − S₀ the contract difference); A₁(ω) = ∫_{G∖Q_r} f_{S₀} dH^k; A₂(ω) = ∫_{Q_r} f_{S₀′} dH^k. Assume also S′(ω) = S(ω) + Z(ω) for every test n-form ω. Then M_W(S′) ≤ M_W(A₁) + M_W(A₂) + M(E′) in [0, ∞] (M_W = massOn W, M = mass).

S₀) (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) + E' ω) → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, A₁ ω = ∫ t in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) : Set (Euclid P)) \ {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval S₀ (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) → (∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n) (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, A₂ ω = ∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval S₀' (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S' ω = S ω + Z ω) → S'.massOn W ≤ A₁.massOn W + A₂.massOn W + E'.mass
